raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 144 txn_ids delivered twice as exact copies, identical in every column including batch_id and ingest_ts. The silver step does not deduplicate, so 136 POSTED keys are duplicated in silver and double-counted in every gold table. Because the copies are byte-identical, collapsing them is a safe, lossless fix.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT DISTINCT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, txn_ts, status, batch_id, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
